profile_text.body:
Beautiful.ai is a software company that offers an AI-powered presentation platform aimed at enterprise teams and businesses of varying sizes. The company describes its product as a tool for building on-brand slide decks faster, citing auto-aligning Smart Slide layouts, over 300 templates, and shared theme controls for brand colors, fonts, and logos. The site positions the platform as serving a range of use cases from sales to strategy, and notes a 14-day free trial with plans available for individuals, small teams, startups, and enterprise customers, with custom pricing available by contacting the sales team.

The company's core AI feature, called Create with AI, is described as a guided, context-aware workflow that takes a user from a short prompt, a written outline, or an uploaded document through to finished slides. Rather than generating a single output, it keeps the user in an iterative loop, allowing edits to structure before committing to design and adjustments to individual slides without regenerating the full deck. The site claims customers including Paciolan and Cvent each cut presentation design time by 75% after adopting the platform, and that IDC analysts reduced production time while surfacing new data insights.

The held facts confirm that Beautiful.ai tracks one product under the Slides and Presentations category, described as a presentation generation tool, consistent with the site's content. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company in the held data.
